versions.content: If development error detection for the module Eep is enabled: the functions Eep_Read() , Eep_Write() , Eep_Compare() and Eep_Erase() shall check that EepromAddress is valid. If EepromAddress is not within the valid EEP- ROM address range they shall raise development error EEP_E_PARAM_ADDRESS , oth- erwise (if no development error detection is enabled) it shall return with E_NOT_OK .
